### [GPT‑6 Astra](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/3/gpt6-astra/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-09-03

OpenAI has begun rolling out GPT-6 Astra, a model designed to compete with Claude Fable, priced at $10 per million input and $50 per million output tokens.

- Achieved 99.9% on the ARC-AGI 3 benchmark using OpenAI's Provider Adapter harness ($19K cost), compared to 62.7% ($26K cost) via the default harness.
- Outperformed GPT-5.6 Sol on security benchmarks, scoring 100% on ExploitBench, 42.4% on ExploitGym, and 99.2% on SRE-Bench binary reverse engineering within four attempts.
- Demonstrated enhanced long-context retrieval on OpenAI's eight-needle benchmark, scoring 100% at 256K–512K tokens and 96.3% at 512K–1M tokens.
- Tied GPT-5.6 Sol at 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (trailing Claude Fable 5.1 and Meta's Muse Spark 1.3), but leads in coding agent cost efficiency.

**Why it matters:** GPT-6 Astra introduces major advancements in security tasks, long-context retrieval, and coding cost efficiency, while highlighting how custom provider harnesses can drastically affect benchmark performance and costs.
